# Yet Another Weekly Update... 🤔
#mood-rad 
For the record, having 'rad' as the best mood for this journal wasn't set by me, it was set by _Daylio_ which I initially used as my journal app a few years ago. Just thought I'd keep it. 

Anyway. It's been a great week since the last update, despite the challenges of the basement water issues and the weather.

## The Storm & The Basement
So sadly we still have water coming into the basement in the addition at the back of the house whenever it rains. Primary reason is a poor lack of drainage/landscaping along the back of the house which causes the water to pool, but a big secondary issue is the fact our sump pump keeps failing. It runs when I give it a nudge, and kicks all the water out into the drain, but it sometimes doesn't recognize the water build up and I come down to 2+ inches of water again until I nudge it 

Thankfully Kyle is going to help us by drilling a hole for us to:
* Replace the sump pump
* Change the drainage from the sewer drain (horrible idea and against code) to the backyard. 
I'm excited for this change and thankfully a new sump pump isn't a load of money. Still need to figure out the electrical issue with the plug under the basement stairs but this will be a huge start. 

### Our Poor Telluride
Sadly the hail did result in some damage to the vehicle with some dents on the hood, roof and along the edges of the passenger and driver sides. I've filed a MPI claim, and it's going to take some time as I have to go get a quote or get it fixed at a particular shop. I haven't looked into it yet but I'm sure all the shops are backed up with hail damage work. I also took the truck in for it's 2nd service since we bought it (400 bucks!) and they aren't sure if Kia will cover the rust spots on the drivers door kick plate so I have to go get another quote for that too. Yay. At least the vehicle is ready for our trip soon! 

## The Catch Up 
* Been playing a bunch of Diablo 4 in my free time which works super well on the SteamDeck shockingly. Even got a session in with Graeme and Paul which was great. Probably the first time in months we have gamed together. 
* The garden is continuing to grow and I'm tending to it practically everyday. Weeding, watering, and my first trim/harvest yesterday of some mustard greens. Used them in some chicken salad sandwiches for Hanna and I today too! Feels good. I'm really enjoying it. 
* Asher and Margaux continue to have issues sleeping but we continue to strive to support them and be there when they need us. I do hope for a better evening routine one day where the kids sleep all night most of the time.... Even as I write this I have a wiggling Asher avoiding sleep beside me.
* Financially we are still tight but are almost through the mortgage process and signed off on the change of deed and ownership at the lawyers yesterday. Feels good to not have my Dad as part of it. We own this house. Together. Now once the renewal is actually done we can pay off our credit cards and get excited for the next part....
* Renovations! We're leaning towards a full kitchen renovation from IKEA, which would be a huge change. Plus built-ins in every area of the house, repairs to the bathroom, new basement windows and a bunch of maintenance stuff. That will be incredibly exciting. Plus maybe we tear the deck down...

Anyway. Time to cuddle this kid and then once he's finally asleep go and deal with the never wanting to sleep daughter who is currently being wrangled by Nanny but is likely not getting tired at all... Hoping i have time to do dishes, lunches and garden ... And maybe even game before they wake up again...

# Brain Overload & Massive Storm with Tornado Warnings 
#mood-good 
It's been a bit of a busy time the last 30 hours or so. I know I'm overdue for a proper journal entry since my last entry was on June 5, but frankly my mind is overloaded with one singularly focus at the moment which is dealing with the aftermath of last night's huge storm. 

Not a storm we usually get a lot of in Winnipeg, a supercell thunderstorm lined up to hit Winnipeg for hours with torrential rain, high winds and tornado warnings galore. I think my phone had an emergency alert 45+ times. I ended up being able to raid last night (which was a miracle in the first place since I had decided to format my entire gaming rig), and as we were playing the warnings kept going off. 

There was heavy hail the size of loonies or golf balls and the Telluride got damaged with a few dings across the hood and elsewhere which is a huge bummer. Thankfully it is covered by Autopac but still a hassle. Then came the water, which was incredible fast and heavy. I hadn't realized it, but our sump pump wasn't working and the basement under our small addition at the back of the house started to slowly fill with water. Ended up having about 2 to 3 inches, and I desperately tried to suck it up with our shop vac. Sadly the shop vac is small, only about 15L max, and it was stopping at about 2/3's full, so it was a lot of going out into the yard and dumping it, going back downstairs to suck more up and repeat. I think I took out maybe 25 to 30 buckets which started to really fuck with my back.

Out of desperation and maybe a faint hope, I tried plugging the sump pump into an extension cord and miraculously it sputtered back to life and quickly pumped all the water out and into the sewer line (which is how it was setup when we bought this house). That's a whole thing on its own which we hope to resolve soon, with a generous offer from my parents to pay for someone to change it to dump out into the backyard as required by bylaw/code. So the issue wasn't the sump pump, it was the outlet/electrical the sump pump was connected to under the basement stairs. Argh. Just another thing for the long and constantly evolving todoist list. That app is honestly a life saver. 

So today I took the day off from work, having to use a vacation day (ugh!) and slept in after the kids left for daycare/school after being up all night with the storm and water. Prepared to get started on remediation in the addition basement by cleaning, gutting and tossing all the shit that was damaged by water, so I went to Canadian Tire and Home Depot to snag tools and supplies to get the job done. Cleaner, mold remover/preventer, masks, drop sheets, crowbar, claw hammer, tarp, floor cleaner, floor squeegee, brush and so on. Even though we are basically broke until Friday (and the fucking bank finishes the mortgage renewal) I had transferred all I had left in my TFSA to our account and used that. 

Got a good amount done - just need to finish removing the bottom quarter of the drywall, then scrub down the moldy/dirty water damaged frame work, soak it in a mix of bleach and water, let it dry and then apply the mold preventer. Then cleanup the floor properly. It's a lot of work but this is the kind of thing I wouldn't do myself or even try to do before, so I'm actually pretty proud of myself for getting on it and getting it done. And I haven't dropped the ball on lunches for the kids or other pieces of day to day life. Before bedtime tonight when my parents dropped off the kids, I threw all their clothes into the wash too. 

## Other Bits
* Working on finishing items on my ever long list with the homelab, including adding all my rough notes from Obsidian to Bookstack. Gemini is a real help in this thankfully. 
* I had to fix the Plex server remote access as it was doing some funky things due to old DNS settings. Also had to fix a few settings on some docker services and UnRaid/Tailscale due to the local subnet change with the new ISP.
* Garden is well watered now, I think the plants took a real beating but I hope they continue to grow. The lettuce, mustard and tomato's seem to be thriving. My seedlings are slow to go it seems but I have a couple spinach and 2 cucumbers that are probably ready to be transplanted this weekend. 
* Our camp trip is coming up and we were hoping to maybe get a hitch on the truck in time but I suspect we will be tenting it as normal due to the delay in getting funds from the mortgage renewal. Annoying. I need to remind Hanna to book the hotels. 
* Work is okay - but I need to really recommit myself to a hard day's work, my focus has been elsewhere which is understandable. 
* As I mentioned I did completely refresh my gaming rig with both drives being reformatted and a fresh windows install. Feels like new again. I probably didn't need to but I like to do that every so often. 

Margaux is rolling about beside me refusing to sleep so it's time for me to end this and get back to helping her get to sleep. 

#storm #house #damage #proud #family

# A Tough Morning; But A Great Day
#mood-rad 
This morning started as bad as it really could after for last night went. I was able to raid after Asher went to bed, which was nice as it's my only real social time. Came up to bed at 1030, played some SteamDeck and went to bed. Not a great sleep though. And then in the morning, the money stress that Hanna and I are both enduring at the moment got the best of her, and she sorta blamed me for it, sharing that be Dad helping us may have been better. The fact of the matter though, is I've been putting out 3 to 4 budget updates a month for the last 2+ years since we took over (at her insistence) to ensure we were in control. And I've diligently captured our finances in YNAB that entire time. I've reported when we are overspending, and I've even tried to say no to Florida, to Mexico, and to my trip in Ireland. And even Rupert, since that added a lot of costs to our monthly budget too. But I always relented, as I want Hanna to be happy. And I've overspent too. Games, technology, household and vehicle stuff... 

My point was that we are a team and we make mistakes together and we learn together. Once our mortgage renewal is done, we'll be able to pay off our credit card debt, and a few other debts and the budget each month is going to be far healthier. We have pledged to hold each other accountable and I'm going to really be that 'no we can't afford it' guy if I have to be. 

I expressed how hurt I was, and how sorry I am for my previous mistakes, and how I'm open to take accountability. I've always done and will continue to learn to be better. That's all I wanted to be seen as. I can't sit in the sorrow and anger of past mistakes, it serves no purpose beyond making me depressed. I take the lesson, and move forward with the knowledge I've gained. It's the only way. 
## The Rest Of The Day
The rest of the day was really great though, I definitely napped a bit longer than I should have, but I got the 'super important' DM Blog out at with with the new wellness site that I had to strongly advocate for. In the end they agreed and followed my recommendations, which was a relief. April and I are going to push hard on finishing the rest of the intranet migration before this micro manager ADM gets his hands into it.... 

I took my lunch outside and got some seedlings started again for the second round of planting for my garden. Peas, lemon balm, iceberg lettuce, carrots, and more. I'm really enjoying the gardening. I'm hopeful it'll work out, but I will need more potters and some rabbit fencing to keep them out... 

I picked up the kids after work, we drove home with ac/dc blasting (they love thunderstruck) and the windows down as it wasn't too hot, but it's supposed to be scorching this weekend. Mowed the front and seeded the grass, then we went upstairs to watch My Neighbor Totoro for the first time as a family and we loved it. I worked on Hanna's laptop on my scootr.ca revision and I'm hoping to pull all my old posts into the one site. It'll be quite the archive if I can do that... Maybe Claude can help make it faster. 

Anyway. Margaux is asleep beside me and I think Hanna and I are going to hang in bed. I'm going to keep working on my site too. A really nice Friday in the end. 

Reminds me of something a friend told me once..
> A bad morning doesn't mean it's going be a bad day.

# Either Side; It's Excruciatingly Hard For Parents
#mood-awful 
One of those days where I just felt behind all day, even though I ate a decent lunch and got some work done, I felt distracted and couldn't even focus on much during my workday. I ended up playing some games to try to reset the brain but no luck. Not sure why today - but just feeling a bit off and that causes me so much stress now because it feels like when I'm not super energized or positive that my whole life and marriage and routine is at risk. It's hard to not be traumatized by the threat of disruption and Hanna getting upset. That said she reassured me that I was doing fine - but my goodness the kids tonight have been challenging. Margaux is really struggling to listen, which is normal, but she needs to push the boundaries and show her independence I guess. She threw gold leaf everywhere from the crafts kit and ignored Hanna telling her no over and over. Then she gets upset that she's told she isn't listening. Toddlers! 

Even Hanna was tired, overstimulated and short with the kids tonight and I tried to be the one to take over but the kids often just run to Mom which makes it feel like I'm practically useless even though they will calm and then say they love me, want to cuddle me, etc. Hanna and I had a miscommunication about who was putting who to bed tonight, she had mentioned that Asher really needed mom time and I said okay you can put him to bed, but then Hanna switched that right as we were going to bed so first Margaux lost her mind thinking I was putting her to bed, then once we confirmed I was putting Asher to bed, he lost his mind. Both kids just crying their heads off and nothing I can do to help but be the '2nd choice'. Ugh. Lying beside Asher right now and unlike most nights he isn't letting me cuddle him, he's just banging the wall and pushing away from me. It sucks. It hurts. 

Had a headache all day, and just honestly kinda feel like crying as not being enough for everyone is so hard. I'm here, patient, loving and supportive but it's just that phase of Mom being the top choice. I guess it makes it that much more special when I'm the top choice when that happens occasionally. And I know it's not easy for Hanna either, being overwhelmed by the kids in needs, them literally crawling all over her and repeating momma momma momma over and over, no matter what side of the coin it's just hard. Being parents is a real trip sometimes. 

But I know I'm in the right spot. Just lying beside him. Hoping he goes to sleep. I'm likely to miss or be late for the raid night in WoW yet again and it just sucks. I have 100+ things in my todoist to do and research and work on and I just don't see how I'll ever have time to do it. It's that hopelessly overwhelmed and disappointed feeling right now and I am journaling to try to let that feeling be processed so I can move on. 

Life is good. It's just hard some days. Being a parent can be hard. And that's ok. I'm here to love this family and do whatever I am able to. Every day. Every night. 

And tomorrow is another day. 

#toughday #family #parenting

# A Quick Catch Up Entry 
#mood-meh 
I'm a bit frustrated and tired. We have a new ADM at the head of our division at work and he's yet another micro manager who wants to meddle in things he knows nothing about. Directing me to change site elements like breadcrumbs or remove the page title from a page. Not only is this poor practice but it also violates the Manitoba Accessibility Act, but he seems to think he can just have whatever he wants. It reduces me and my teammates to glorified copy paste monkeys in leadership's mind and I'm honestly done with it. I pushed back pretty hard, but in a professional and clear way. I'm happy I'm pushing back on what amounts to poor decisions and extremely misguided edits that destroy any hope of having an established architecture and common page patterns for our users. I know I'm on the side of the end users so I'm very confident I'm on the right end of this. I mean, it literally is my job to be the expert in this area and I can guarantee the ADM has no fucking clue.

### Quick Updates
As a result of this and being solo with the kids after my parents drop then off and leave, I'm pretty exhausted so I'll just do some quick updates. 

* Margaux was sick for a couple days this week with a flu or some stomach bug. Poor girl made a mess of her bed and stayed home for two days. 
* Hanna and I continue to go though the hoops and process of getting our mortgage renewal done with the extra funds for debt consolidation and Renos. We're really excited to pick what projects we can afford to do. Might start with something simple like restaining the fence. 
* Our kids continue to not sleep at night for more than a few hours at a time. Margaux basically comes to our bed by 2am every night and Asher wakes up usually around midnight yelling for Mom so it's just me and Margaux in the master bed most nights which is kinda hard to do every single night. The kids feel loved and cared for though so that's what matters, it's just the parents sleep and relationship that suffers 😂
* Fitbit was replaced by Google Health which actually has been really good so far. Because we have Google One, we get the enhanced pro version which has a AI coach which has really helped me understand the metrics a bit better, provides personalized recommendations and makes logging did a lot easier and less time consuming. I've been trying to use it properly all week and it's really helped keep me active and more aware of how my body is functioning, and what decisions I make can do. More walks and even got back on the Pelaton this week. 
* I've become a bit of a garden nut, I guess I got the bug. I transplanted all the veggies and herbs I got to grow successfully in the seed starters, and I've slowly been having to get more soil to expand the garden. Got a decent setup in the back corner of the yard with a bunch of stuff growing so far. I'm going to try to start more seeds this week too. 
* Gaming, I've got my spot back in the primary raid team in WoW and that's been a relief. The content is hard and the upgrades are far slower to get but I'm glad to be back in regularly and having Hanna be on board for it. I don't think she realizes how little I go out and how much I truly have put aside to be home. Lots of Dad's, including her friends husbands, go out with friends multiple times a week and I'm just doing having for 2 hours on Tuesdays and Thursdays after the kids have gone to bed. I want to play more games, but just hard to find time that doesn't make Hanna feel like I'm not prioritizing family or her. Not sure how I'll be able to ever play a team sport until the kids are much older... 
* The server is running really well and our new Internet is fantastic. We switched to Bell, which I swore I would never ever do, but they have direct fibre to our house and we are getting 3GBPS both ways, which for the server services is incredible. I'm really pleased so far. And it's cheaper than what we had with Rogers/Shaw. Win! 

It's thundering outside as the thunderstorms continue the last couple of days. Kind of expected after 2 weeks of +30C.. normally I'd hate that kind of heat but with the gardening and the walks I've been out in it a lot more. Probably good for me. We just had a tornado warning too but it's for outside of the city. Scary for some I'm sure. 

Just waiting for Margaux to go to sleep now so I can make lunches and maybe have some time to game before Hanna gets home but I'm starting to think I yet again won't have time for me to unwind....

# A Busy Birthday Week - Margaux Turns Three 
#mood-rad 
It's going to be hard to remember everything that has gone down over the past few days, but I'll try my best. It's been honestly, a really busy, tiring but lovely few five days since I last journalled. 

Firstly - it was Margaux's 3rd birthday on Tuesday, which we celebrated on Monday night with my family over for home made pizza, salads, cold drinks and cake pops. The cake pops were made by Hannas former employee Allison and were super good, but super sweet. Definitely doesn't help my pre-diabetic blood sugar levels! She got her first bike from my parents, some Frozen figures and a karaoke machine from my sister's family. That may be something I'll have to pay her back with as it's quite loud, but the kids love it (and I do too).

On Tuesday, her actual birthday I used sick time to not work, and Hanna and I spent time with Margaux in the morning, including picking out a cake. Asher still went to school in the morning but we picked him up, and Calder too around noon and met Hannas best friend from school (Jamie) and his Dad Matt at McDonald's before we went to this play place. The kids had a blast, there was nobody else there so they had the run of the place aside from one kid and his mom. We were there for almost 4 hours before we dropped off Calder and headed home, before quickly heading out again to Colleens for dinner and cake. I think Hanna had a really nice time being able to chat and spend time with her aunt, mom and brother, and Veronika and Andreas came too which was awesome. Margaux was spoiled with dresses, and a makeup kit from V. Dinner was decent as far as dinners go at the inlaws for me, I think I was far too exhausted to be too offended for not being listened to or being interrupted. 

I should mention that my gardening attempt has continued decently. We've cleaned both the front and back yards properly, mowed the grass down and the front garden is waiting for Hanna's touch. As for my veggies/herbs, the seedlings are doing really well (with a couple of small exceptions) and are practically ready to be transplanted to the yard. I've consulted with Gemini on how to do that and have a plan to hopefully get them outside and growing in the back by Sunday. 

Also on Sunday, expecting to get our Internet replaced. Kind of shocking as I said I'd never switch from Shaw/Rogers but a bell guy visited (despite our clear signage) to let us know that direct fibre is available in the neighborhood now. That got me intrigued and I was very curious what they could offer, which ended up being 3GBPS down and 2.5GBPS up, which is far better than the 1GBPS down and 200MBPS up we have now. I could do so much more with the home lab with all that upload bandwidth.... So we are switching. Saves us 45 a month too which is huge right now. 

Speaking of finance, we finally had to go above our loan officers head at Access credit union and contacted a couple managing partners and the branch we originally had our mortgage from. The guy we were dealing with ghosted us and just never called back or emailed back after a month. We needed the mortgage renewal but we also really needed the extra funds to consolidate debt and pay off our credit cards. We are at almost 70k in credit card debt from the past 2 years and Hanna and I have resolved ourselves to stick to our budgets and really say no to things we want, even if it's hard. We just have to do it. We do have a few projects we hope to have money for from the consolidation too, to fix and redo the bathroom, fix and redo the kitchen, tear down the deck and build a simple patio. As well as the already in motion basement window replacements, eaves trough cleaning, duct work cleaning, furnace servicing, and sewer line cleaning we are due for.... Houses are fun right...

Project wise I've been working on finishing up the new scootr.ca redevelopment to use Astro and Keystatic for a simple headless CMS and static file site. It's looking really good, and I admit I'm using Claude Code heavily. It's pretty powerful. Still need to focus on my codecademy course and finish it as it's looking like I'll have to renew the pro subscription in July to give me more time to finish. Waiting for feedback from Hanna on the first rough iteration of her business site and that will keep moving too.

Kids are asleep, bathed and I've got some time to throw dishes in, and maybe go game or putter on a project in the basement before Hanna gets home at 9ish. Been so hot here, so the AC is on to try to keep this old house cold so the basement is frigid. 

Until next time.

I am being incredible patient, just relaxing when the kids go wild, and accidents or bumps happen. Speaking patiently and kindly all the time, and I think Hanna sees the difference, I know I feel its solid and a good routine. 

A busy day to day, up early, breakfasts, spending time with the kids drawing, relaxing together and even walking Rupert together (and by myself). I feel I do have to shortchange work each day to be able to catch up on other things, like how I need to get my ilvl up in WoW for the raids so I can participate again. It's learning. It's finding new routines that work for everyone. # Catch Up; A Few Bumps And Thoughtful Considerations
#mood-good 
It's been too long since I made my last journal entry. Admittedly, it is challenging to find time to do a lot of things in our day to day lives, including exercise, brush my teeth more than once and that includes journaling. I also think I often don't journal enough when things are going well, I often reach for my journal when I need to do a brain dump, express emotions and document how I feel a poor day went. To be fair, thats a fairly good habit to have. But if one day my kids, or Hanna, or some random is reading this (why?), it would be a relatively lop-sided viewpoint on my life. My life is good. I feel a lot of joy, accomplishment and pride in what I do each day. My focus and goals are always family focused, and despite there being the challenges of maintaining a marriage, developing my skills as a parent and coparent, and more - **life is good**. 

I'm journaling before Hanna and I finish the rest of _Project Hail Mary_ which is quite good, and we've just been too tired, or had kids wake, to be able to finish watching it. We've been spending more time together, and I've prioritized being less transparent with my frustration or impatience which means I'm calmer for everyone. Hanna did mention a few days ago that she felt really good, and that "this version of Jeremy" is the one she loves the most. We talked about how my mentals can have ups and downs, and I know thats not easy on her, because it's especially not easy for me. But I feel confident that my lows never dip below the previous one, and the long term trend of my mental strength and ability to handle more inputs, stress and challenging situations is only improving year by year. That said, she made the point that if she feels that I am draining her completely to the point of not being able to take care of all of us, or I'm affecting the kids negatively, that isn't okay. I agree completely. It's not like when I'm stressed, impatient or anxious that I mean to be short, have a angry tone, etc... thats just part of managing my own brains challenges. The ADHD, the GAD, the seasonal depression and the likely autistic features that are undiagnosed. 

So, we had a strong conversation a couple of days ago, where she really expressed her frustration, the trauma she still works through of when I wasn't there for her. And I wasn't. I wasn't well, I was unable to handle so many inputs, stress and pressure of worrying about her long term health. How would I handle it without her? How would I ensure the kids are okay if I can't handle things myself? And I wasn't there, I had a break - when she needed me the most. I regret it every single day, there isn't a moment in time I don't worry about waking up to find my family gone and I'm re-living that day in January 2 years ago all over again. But I have to be mindful of her trauma, how it affected **her** that I didn't do the right things, or bring her confidence and support when she needed it most. I will do anything and everything to atone for this, and I have done nothing but take full responsibility. While it may be true that my own mental health was a huge part of my failure, it is not an excuse, its my own responsibility to ensure I'm healthy for my family and my kids especially. 

## The Yellow Card

So, after that discussion which I cried pretty openly for the first time in a while, I think we both realized we ultimately are always trying to do the same thing, and thats look after our kids and our family. I may not always understand her priorities in some day to day tasks, but with clearer communication, I can understand and ensure I'm pulling the 'cart' in the same direction, in the way she would prefer it to be 'pulled'. And to address that feeling of her having to pull me out of my low 'dips' every year (usually fall/winter, yay seasonal depression), I have suggested we use a yellow card system. It sounds tacky, but I need that clear, simple, but rarely used signal that I need to re-adjust myself and ensure I'm not adding to the already busy and stressful lives we have. I'm hoping this will help me understand better when I'm needing to get back into good routines, instead of falling deeper into a hyper focus for escape, etc.

## Gardening

Speaking of hyper focuses, I am really into my gardening right now. The family and I did the front yard together, cleaning it up for the summer, and I've also seeded a whole load of herbs and veggies. We tried last year and it was kind of a failure, so this year I got mini seed starter kits and seeds, and so far they are growing! Only one or two isn't showing up the way I would have hoped. Soon we'll be transplanting them into the garden outside and then hopefully start some new seeds. This could be a thing... wanting indoor lighting for year round growth... dangerous! 

To wrap this up - we all went to gymnastics yesterday, visited my parents, did the yard together and had a nice movie night in bed with popcorn and 'Swapped'. Today, kids went with Hanna and Colleen to Hide n Seek in the morning, I fixed up a rock wall in the garden, vacuumed the house, and then we went to Pan Am Pool as a family to swim. My god I hate showing my body but it was fun regardless, the kids loved it. We then pushed it by going to Costco and getting some shopping done. It wasn't easy, but it was worth getting it done. 

Hoping to hear from the mortgage/banker guy this week so we can pay off our debts, and REALLY stick our budget going forward. I'm going to be the 'no' guy, if I have to be...

Anyway. Time to watch the movie.

# It's Always A Good, Challenging Day
#mood-meh 
I'm currently lying beside Asher who is upset that it's Dad's turn to put him to bed, and not Mom. It's hard for me to be so rejected, but I'm also trying to understand it from his perspective. He loves having Mom put him to bed, and both kids are usually fighting over who gets Mom. I really don't think it's a reflection of what I do, or how I parent, but it's hard not to feel a bit of sadness and a feeling of failure. I cuddle, reassure and continue to tell him that I love him, he's safe and Mom still comes at night when he wakes up, but he's not calming. 

It's almost like nails on a chalkboard, the whining sound he makes, the repeating of "momma momma", and the hyper ventilation he seems to be doing on his own as it only shows up when I'm trying to reassure him. I just told him he's safe and Mom comes at night, gave him his stuffies, and he kicked them away and told me when I talk I make him cry more. I am kind of at a loss of how to be there for him, so I'm just lying here, trying to be calm and reassuring. I am sad I'm not able to be a solution and that's really triggering for me, because I ultimately want to be a great dad and a rock for my family. I'm hoping he will go to bed soon. 

Luckily, I'm not raiding tonight as Hanna is going out on Thursday, so it makes no sense for me to take a locked slot on a heroic or mythic run when I can't continue on Thursday. I also have a lot of catching up to do gear wise as well, and honestly with the newly redefined routines I don't have the energy or time in the evening to be able to game. Which is kind of depressing honestly, as it's my only time to reduce the inputs on my brain and be able to prepare for the next day without starting with half my brain still processing the day before. I actually have asked Gemini to try to help me explain some of my challenges with ADHD/GAD (and likely autistic features) and it really nailed it with this: 
>  For you, relaxation isn't just sitting down; it’s the absence of input. You need a period where no one is asking for anything, so your brain can finally process the day's events and move them from "active RAM" into "long-term storage." Without this, you start the next day already at 40% capacity.
So often these days I'm starting the next day at 40% capacity unless I stay up gaming or find some time alone, and I think with the new routine, there isn't a lot of room for that. But I'll try to find a healthy balance eventually. 

## Hanna's Websites
In some cool news, I've finally got the go ahead from Hanna to just start creating her websites for the salon and the hair extension line. Initially there was some friction between us and she quickly jumped to saying we couldn't work together, which was pretty hurtful, but I think she needed to understand that when I'm talking through how to deliver her vision on the web, I'm not saying no or being negative, I'm trying to translate one medium to another. We ended up building a rough first draft of the style guide for Therapy Beauty Collective, and today I banged out the first draft of the MVP landing page and it's come out pretty decently. Lots of bits to work on and clean up, refine, but it's a great start and Hanna feels the same way. Big win. 

## Kid's Sleeping 
Something I think has to change in terms of how we approach the kids sleeping routine. I have supported and advocated for her approach, which is we lie beside the kids until they are asleep. We don't put them to bed on their own. But it's seemingly getting worse with Asher and Margaux isn't improving, she's regressing from being able to sleep all night. It's not healthy for them to have such interrupted and co dependent sleeping patterns, and I've come to a point where I'm not sure I can continue supporting this approach without results. The other approaches exist and many parents use them successfully too, and maybe it's time to consider some adjustments so they sleep consistently and more independently. The other portion to this is that Hanna and I also need time for ourselves, for the house, to connect and prepare for the next day. It's not realistic to have us drained and tired and never getting adult time or downtime until 9 or 10pm at night. It's absolutely unsustainable and goes directly against what Hanna is wanting for our improved routines. 

Anyway, Asher is saying he's got a cold now, can't sleep and won't go to sleep until "momma" arrives. Meanwhile, Margaux isn't sleeping either and is now asking for me. But if we came and change things up, the kids know they can just do whatever they want and get whatever they want.... Sigh. 

I'm getting pretty frustrated. My Concerta is worn off and my patience is thin. I'm actually starting to shake with frustration. Maybe it's best we switch. I don't know. I give up. This phase is really hard and I love these kids to death but they may be the death of me and my ability to feel like a human. 

#kids #family #sleeping #websites

# Message To Hanna

#mood-awful 

Tonight, Hanna told me over the phone while I was in Birmingham that life is easier, lighter, the house isn't a mess, all because I'm not home. She also told me that she was surprised that the kids missed me. She talked about how she felt she had compromised things she didn't want to, and that I add a level of stress to life that she didn't realize until I was gone. I am beyond broken right now. Fears, anxiety, so many things. I wrote her a message, which is below and then I'm gonna get out my laptop and journal properly in an effort to find a way to sort out my confused mind. I'm so hurt. Shocked. 

> I really wish we could continue talking. I hate feeling like I've let you down. The only stress I have in life is trying to feel like I'm making you happy, that I'm doing all the right things for our family and being the man you believe I can be. I push myself so hard to be the best father, partner and I pride myself in showing up for you and the kids every single time, no matter what. I'm sorry that you've felt that stress - but I just never know if I'm prioritizing the right thing and I try so hard to do it. I'm sorry that things are easier without me around. My heart is breaking and I just want to crawl in a hole until I can fly home. I hate that no matter how hard I try it always feels like the tighter I grip priorities, the more fall through my fingers like wet sand. All I want to do is to be good enough and feel I'm on solid ground and can be safely myself, light and funny, without worrying that if I share something hard, like the lack of sleep and time we have had to connect, without it being seen as me having a breakdown, instead of what it is, which is feeling safe to be able to be honest when I'm frustrated or struggling for good connections, with my teammate and partner. I feel like often I can't show honesty because it's all you remember and it makes you hyper focus on it, and I have to be fake and completely solid like the man you want instead of the man I am. We both get tired. We both have hard days and I guess I thought we should be able to lean on each other, like you can lean on me when life gets hard or tiring. I am not weak. I am not someone who wants to be stressed but I feel like I'm constantly failing a test I don't have the actual questions for so I'm just trying to do as much as I can in as many areas as possible to get a passing grade and be seen as useful and wanted. 

> I am so sad because I just don't understand how so much effort and so much sacrifice doesn't equal some sort of safe feeling of being loved for all my ups and downs. I do everything I can for the family and I strive to be more capable everyday and I feel I have been. 

> I have never asked you to compromise, ever and I'm sorry that is what you did, but I wouldn't want you to do that. I'm sorry it feels like I am not as good as I was before but I am trying to be so much and carry so many cards and just feel like I am loved and on solid ground and can throw away the worries and fears that it's all gonna be for nothing. Nothing matters more than you and the kids..nothing. I'm sorry if it ever seems like I'm not on the right priority but it's always a priority I see as something for our family. I'm so sad and heartbroken and confused and just feel like I can't ever do anything in life, like I'm just built wrong and I'll never be successful at anything I put my whole soul into. It's so heartbreaking. 

> But whatever you need I'm there. If I have to sacrifice having any time to myself I'm willing to do it, no matter the cost. I'm sorry you ever felt like I wasn't there for you but all I feel and know in my heart is that all I've done and sacrificed has not been easy for me and I'm doing it all for our family. There are much easier paths and I won't ever choose a path that doesn't include you or the kids. I'm so sorry that I've let this anxiety that I have about being good enough show in the way it does.

# Our House Is An Infection Zone, 2 Days Until Ireland 
#mood-good 

Friday was the last day at work and it went well. Handed off all remaining work, which wasn't much as I tried to finish anything before I left for two weeks, and said goodbye. Told everyone I'll be updating my Instagram as I travel with pictures and such. I'm excited. I'm nervous. I don't want to say goodbye to my family. But I also know this could be an incredible adventure and a bit of self growth. But man will I miss the kids and Hanna. And June. And even Rupert. 😭 

Saturday, today, we spent most of the day at home. Margs had gymnastics, and while Hanna took her there, Asher and I went to Costco to get myself new jeans, socks and a mondeta hoodie for my trip. It's very "hey I'm Canadian" but I'm hyped to wear it after too. So that's two new hats, plus these clothes and that's all I've bought for the trip clothing wise. I did also buy plug converters for charging devices, and a really solid power Bank for the flights. I feel relatively prepared even though I haven't packed yet. After Costco, Asher and I went to get donuts, he wanted to do that on Friday but we didn't have time. In fact on Friday when I picked him up, he was kinda sad as he wanted to go have a picnic at the pan am pool playground, but with Margaux having stayed home on Friday as she was so sick, we couldn't do it. So we promised him we would do that on the weekend, and on Friday he wanted to watch me play Arc Raiders, so that's exactly what we did. Got slurpees, snacks and some red licorice for him to try which he deemed "medium". 😂 So I got to eat it 🥰 anyway, donuts were also promised. We're going to go to the playground and get some McDonald's tomorrow after swimming to fulfill the promise. 

In terms of stuff I need to do, I need to do the hydro meter readings for gas and power, clean the litter, vacuum the basement and then start packing. I also need to go to the bank on Monday to exchange the cash my parents gave me for my birthday for Euros. I'm trying to remain chill and try to enjoy my time with the family and maybe even a bit of downtime just for me to play games and stuff. Been pushing my tasks in todoist to after the trip when possible. 

Speaking of tasks, the media server is almost fully restored, only about 6k episode files left to snag and then it's completely recovered. Due to the change in quality with the new arr stack automation, the size is a bit larger, probably going to end up closer to 30TB usage instead of 22TB for the same amount of movies and TV, but I'm really happy. I've also got audiobooks, ebooks working for everyone so I'm happy about that. And today the final big task was to do a full security audit, so I completed a report from an app, and then did a full firewall (ufw) review, and cleaned up, documented and made sure all the rules were appropriate. I had to fix a couple things to ensure the pihole DNS and DHCP worked, and then it was golden. I think the server is extremely secure now, especially with the cloudflare zero trust layer, tunnels and the docker containers. I've learned a lot and I know I've only scratched the surface. I'm actually spinning up what is supposed to be a free oracle cloud virtual remote server, with Ubuntu, 4 CPUs and 24GB RAM with 200GB of boot storage, so I'm going to use it as a test box for things. 

I've also updated the mi laptop I took over from Hanna to the latest version of Linux Mint, and so far everything is working ok. I'm impressed. I'm going to try remotely playing a game in a bit and see how it goes. 

The kids are clearly going to miss me while I'm gone, which definitely gives me heart a little tug, and I'm really going to miss them. It's really all I'm thinking about when I'm not distracting myself with something. I hope I don't cry on the goodbyes on Monday night, but I have a feeling I'm going to cry when I see them when I get back. 

One thing I really got to do before I go is share all my passwords with Hanna on last pass so if something happens she can go through my stuff and maybe even find this journal. I don't want her to feel lost and overwhelmed. We also really need to do our wills, which I've been thinking about. I worry far too much but I don't want anything to go wrong, and if it does, I want my family to be able to read my journals and go through all my stuff. Inherit my game libraries... 

Anyway enough of that.. I'm going to cuddle Margaux now until she falls asleep. She's so damn cute. And Asher gets me tomorrow night, the last bedtime before I leave. 

A lot to think about...

# I Took A Sick Day And Was Productive? 
#mood-good 

Another night of coughing, chills and sweats, for both Hanna and me. Another night of the kids waking early. We had a long discussion yesterday because Hanna was feeling little I didn't want to spend time, which was bullshit of course, as I absolutely love seeing her and boring her with my little projects and the thoughts bouncing around my ADHD brain. But she had felt this and I really had to push back on it, because she was just feeling it as I'm going away to Ireland on Monday, and I had my raiding event on Tuesday nights. I don't see friends, I rarely talk to friends, and truthfully I look forward to the wow raiding nights because it is a bit of socialization. That being said, after I finally convinced her it's more that we both have been busy and just haven't been able to connect because of busy days and unsettled kids, I was far too tired and felt sick so I just went to bed after I got Asher to sleep. 

Morning was early today as Hanna had her neurologist appointment, and it went well in the sense she has been told she doesn't need to see him anymore. She was pretty emotionally affected, as she's thankful (as am I) that she's navigated Gillian Barrett Syndrome twice now in her life. She's very lucky. The doctor said she could have been in a wheelchair. That's scary to think about and I still find it hard to put it in my head and consider it. I find I have to live in the present and be thankful and not think about what that would be like to just ensure I don't lose it. But it's good news, and she's taking really good care of her body and that should help prevent a 3rd flare-up. So after she had her appointment I picked her up, and I had already dropped off the kids, cleaned the car, done a recycling cardboard run, and made breakfast. Not bad. 

I ended up taking the day sick as I just haven't been very productive at work with the sickness and the work I took on with the server, reorganizing all the docker containers, adding VPN, etc. but that's all pretty well setup now. It's just about maintenance and monitoring now, I'm holding myself back from adding anything else for now. Probably a good idea, I have a load of documentation to do, taking my rough slapped notes in obsidian and moving them into an organized BookStack instance. I'm looking forward to doing that and feeling like I have a good Bible of information. Probably going to rely on NotebookLLM to help me do most of that if I'm honest. 

Hanna got her new laptop today, so I set that up, got a couple basics installed and removed the pre-installed garbage. It's a really nice laptop, a new ASUS. It's going to be night and day for her. And with that, I took over her sorry excuse for a laptop she was using, a shitty Chinese mi laptop with just 4GB of ram. Insane it did anything honestly. I backed up her files and then decided to throw Linux Mint on it, I've never used that distro and it seemed like a good lightweight option for the specs. It's wildly fast on it, considering the hardware and I'm just trying to get a few tools setup so it can be a nice like work laptop for development or education for me while I'm in bed.

Oh. Oh. I also finally, after two years, forced myself to fix the back fence gate. It didn't take very long and I'm really glad it's done. The gate was literally about to fall off it's last bolt. 

Talk about being productive on a sick day I needed to rest.... My parents brought the kids home, bit of dinner, bit of paw patrol, got Asher to bed and then came to Margaux's room and she's now sleeping soundly beside me. She's getting the same cough Hanna and I had... Poor girl. I'm going to sneak out of here and try to have a shower before I make lunches and then lounge around in bed. Which I forgot to mention, our new TV had issues and I returned and exchanged that today too, and set it back up.... So we can hopefully watch a show in bed together tonight. 🥰

# A Busy Sunday and Still Sick 🤧 
#mood-good 
We bought a new TV for the bedroom, a Roku so we can watch something and listen to it on our earbuds together through the Roku app. It's pretty awesome, and it was 'only' 329. Not bad for a 50" 4k. Kinda interesting Hanna went for it. We had hoped to watch stuff tonight last night but I took too long trying to get the books pipeline working properly on the server. Primarily because I know Hanna would really value it but I think she probably would have preferred me hanging out with her. My bad, I always struggle to prioritize all the things we have in front of us each day. 

This morning was the kids swimming lessons which was good, with Hanna and I still dragging along with very hoarse voices. Then we went to my parents for a brunch to celebrate my upcoming birthday since I would be out of the country. They got me some cash for the trip (I'll use it to pay down the cards) and a Portugal national team kit. Pretty nice.

# Our Routine Is Hard

#mood-meh 

It's something I've been thinking about and struggling with for a while, the routine we have with our kids at bedtime. The lack of independence that seems to be either delayed or non-existent with Asher, needing us in the room with him all the time, or getting scared in his room or the room beside ours if we're not in it. The constant need for "momma", no matter how patient, caring and loving I am, it is becoming devastating to my ability to find calm and peace so I can reset and get to the next day with the positive energy required. The struggles to get Margaux to sleep, which can stretch into 8, 9, sometimes 10pm each night for us. Where are we supposed to find rest and our own time for our brains to explore, read, nuture and reset? I have no idea.

I am trying to be more present and mindful when I'm with the kids, and what that means is the time I would normally have where my Concerta is still pumping in my body from the end of work until bedtime (~7pm) is spent with the kids, or trying to be doing stuff as a family. There isn't anything wrong with this, and I'm happy to do whatever is needed, truly. But the result is tough for me, which is that when I get out of the bedroom between 8pm or 9pm, my energy is sapped - the Concerta is fading, and I'm getting into the "BLEH" of feeling I have no time to really get into much. No time to commit to a sports team if I wanted to play. A rushed exercise in trying to meet up with my guildies in WoW for regular activities, which I try to enjoy. Feeling like all I do is slam tasks and ideas into my notes or apps, to be looked at one day when I have time, and then it feels like an absolute weight on me, instead of the joy of learning, relaxing and creating that it should be. The type of stuff that lets my mind and body relax, to reset, to find who I "am", and continue to expand what I can do. To feel empowered and intelligent and useful. It's so hard. Weekends aren't really an option to sit and do things I enjoy all day, as that would be selfish too, it can't all be on Hanna to do weekends, and I know that, but I can still acknowledge how hard it is to find time to really deep dive into things these days. 

Every bedtime is a muted panic attack. My heart races, the BPM increases, I get sweaty, and it becomes harder to stay calm, cool and collected, and I work so hard on improving this every single night with the kids. I love them, I adore our life, I'm thankful for our family, but that doesn't mean I can't acknowledge how hard it is for my own brain, my own body, to find rest in the exploration of things I enjoy. If I stay up late, I end up super tired in the morning, no matter how much enjoyment I got the night before diving into a project or gaming, I'll be exhausted and not helpful in the morning as I should be. If I go to bed early, I will get _some_ rest, but I'll still feel zonked because I didn't actually get a chance to decompress from the day, work, life, tasks, brain shooting a 1000mi a second. There seems to be no middle ground I can find to really, truly, be the geek I want to be, sitting at my computer, letting the ideas and creativity flow. But, being able to express it, journal it, and #braindump it, sure helps a lot.

I'm thankful I've setup memos and imported all my old daylio journal entries. It feels safe, private and useful to be able to journal again. I just feel like when I feel overwhelmed, I am ultimately letting my family, and especially Hanna, down. Like I have to be this incredible, strong entity that can't show weakness so that people know I'm capable and willing to always be there and do what needs to be done. And I am, I feel I am. But when I feel this way, when I feel a bit lost to find time for my own decompression time, it feels like a weakness that is being exposed to those I care about most, like I can practically hear my Mom in my head telling me some advice that ultimately just tells me I failed. It's a mix of sadness, frustration and despair I guess. And I process it everyday, and move into the next day as best I can, always trying to improve and I guess that's all I can do. 

It is Friday, thankfully. I think Hanna and I are doing our movie/show night tomorrow, since today was a bit messy with Asher being sick the last two days, and trying to work while hes at home, desperate for someone else than me. I was loving, patient, kind and even got him some new Minecraft books, but alas - Mom is still the one, and thats ok. Hanna is pretty neat, you know, I did marry her. 😂

Plan for the night? Try to keep working on:
- dynacat widgets I've developed with help from Claude Code
- work on dynacat pages for projects/tasks, and gaming.
- maybe setup readmeabook and audiobookshelf on the homelab. 
- maybe even play some games....

Do they care about how they treated me? I feel dumb for feeling this way. I feel so much rejection and hurt. I feel I was abandoned in a time of need. 2020 was hard. First Margs gets bumped by Rupert and she is bleeding hard from her nose, she got knocked face first into the front window. Really not great and caused a lot of stress. I found that because I had forgotten to take my meds this morning, and how overheated and mentally tired I was, I didn't react well. Then a few minutes later after we had put Rupert into the sunroom, I see that he is chewing parts of the brand new axe and dart set. I lost my cool, yelled at the dog and didnt handle it well. I was so frustrated and sick of this puppy destroying so much every single day. Add to that my mom is always fucking criticizing our house and how it's hard to find things.... We are trying to keep things together and keep things away from the dog...

3 min after I took the stuff from him and started looking for replacement pieces (which apparently don't exist), I see him chewing up one of Ashers helicopter toys and I just blew my top. I yelled at the dog and then dragged and pushed him outside so he couldn't do anymore damage. I was so angry and sick of him destroying shit, we have bought him every toy under the sun to try to get him to use his own shit... Ugh. 

It wasn't a great response. I would have liked to redo that moment but I didn't have my meds and my patience and overheated head really did me in. Still my fault of course. Especially in front of the kids. 

What really ended up being the most hurtful cherry on top was that Hanna got mad at me. She didn't have my back. I've seen her lose it on the kids, on the dog, on others, ranting and angry and I've made it a point to always have her back. Always. No matter what. That's what partners do. But I'm getting the feeling that is a one way deal sometimes and this was one of those times. I get my response wasn't great. I get that I be should be more understanding of the puppy being young. He doesn't know what he's doing wrong. But he really does scare me and the feeding of not being about to relax because he's going to destroy something is really hard. 

I really find it frustrating to not know if I'm standing on solid ground with Hanna or not. I with my butt off but I still have fear that at any moment she's going to pull the rug out from under me. I just want to see that empathy and understanding she has for others for me and my mental health struggles too and they rarely happen now. So I guess I thought that meant she would have my back like I have hers. 

I'm going to apologize to the dog and give him some love. Try to repair. I'm going to apologize again to the kids tomorrow morning and explain that some days my brain gets really hot and overwhelmed and I should have not been so quick to get angry with Rupert. He's just a puppy. 

I just feel really down now. Down on myself. Down on my brain and frustrated that I forgot my meds and thought I could get though the long day no problem. I really hope Asher remembers all the amazing things he got and did today and not me getting upset. I just seem to ruin everything when the stakes are at their highest and the pressure is on. I really hate my brain and myself sometimes. I would do anything to not have this brain and be able to be understood and loved, and supported no matter how imperfect I am. 

Rocking Margs to sleep now and maybe I'll just go to bed. I had so much positive energy and was so excited for this evening but now I'm just sad and feeling fucking depressed.

I asked Hanna if I could nap while the dishes finished since I couldn't make lunches until it was done. She freaked out on me about the question. It made no sense to me. She blames me for the kids being focused on her that she is doing most of the kid rearing but that's not me crafting that situation. That has nothing to do with my effort, focus or tasks on a day to day. She completely ignores that there is large parts of the cards I hold that are in certain categories that she doesn't do anything or when she says she'll do it, it doesn't get done and is left to me. I just do it. We're a team. I see it as my job to jump in on what needs to be done.

So when the kids choose her, I see that as her jumping in where she excels and she is jumping in on what needs to be done. 

I also think it's unfair and frankly hurtful to have to be a half fake version of myself around the kids and pretend I'm not into computers, technology, video games.... This is like 90 percent of my interests but they have been deemed "bad" even though they led me to the success and skills I have today. It feels like who I am is being shamed and being told it was just a fluke I ended up using these skills to better my life and my kids/families lives by making it a career.

I feel completely invalided, belittled and shamed for doing all I can for this family in every aspect and area of our lives that I can. If I try forcing the kids to come with me on errands or tasks, and they don't want to go, they cry and flop and ask for mom, and then she intervenes anyway... Because she doesn't want them upset... But that's my fault??

I tell my kids I love them and spend time with them, welcoming them home, dropping them off, picking them up and trying so hard to be everything I can. I'm stretching myself as thin as possible and the result is - when I ask for some rest so I can be at my best, it triggers my partner, who also asks for rest when she needs it and I always support that? It sucks to feel like I don't matter or my rest or my needs don't matter. That my skills and interests don't matter. That all the successes and celebrated things she compliments me on are just washed away in a moment of frustration and she doesn't see or understand that I lose all that good feelings and confidence in a moment and have to rebuild from scratch again. Whenever I feel confident in my space, my ability as a dad, as a provider, as a partner, it is ripped back down. It sucks. I'll never feel comfortable or safe I guess. I always have to be on edge and question myself and criticize myself that I'm not doing enough. Which is basically what Hanna does to herself already which I try so hard to tell her she's amazing and that she always does enough and to not be hard on herself but I think she thinks it's a positive thing to see people be hard on themselves and never be comfortable?

I don't know.. I'm super hurt. Really sad.

Today was a day. Year since separation. Started the day off with Hanna missing the point of why it was hard for me to mark it. It was the lowest and most traumatic moment of my life. I have taken accountability and been making amends without hiding from the effects on her, for nearly a year. I needed her to think about how hard it was on my behalf and the fears I still have. She eventually got it. 

Then, more barbs and frustration my way when the plan for how the kids swimming lessons would go didn't happen. Again, I apologized and shared what I was thinking when I tried to get a task done she earlier wanted done but then didn't at the time I did it. I tried to ask once again, a recurring theme lately, for patience, understanding! Pointing out that she seems to understand my brain when she sends me all these tiktok links and videos but when things get rough on BOTH of us, she snipes and goes hard at me. I'm always learning and trying. I'm not perfect. I am not her. But good God I try to learn and continue to say sorry when I make the wrong decision with a card in trying to carry for us. 

Family is everything. She did end up apologizing for getting frustrated at me but it's hard to come back from that.

Found out the details of my heart concern. It wasn't as bad as I worried thankfully but still not great.

So I have a very "nothing" (her words) finding, but something she wanted to share and keep an eye on. It's called a left anterior fascicular block. It's a slight timing difference between the left and right ventricle. It's extremely uncommon in young people (my age) - and often causes no symptoms. She compared it to some people have freckles and some who don't, it's just a difference. However, in older people it can be indicative of heart issues down the line. 

That said, we will be doing an echo (an ultrasound of the heart) since it's not evasive and an easy test to do, she described doing the test as an 'overkill' but just figuring it's easy to do so let's do it. I will also be doing a 6 month recheck of EKG and blood work and likely have regular checks to keep on it.

Blood work looked ok. Same recommendations, watch carbs and sugars (but not when on vacation she said lol). I asked if there were any concerns about flying or ramping up physical activity, and she says no, no concerns at all. 

Recommendations overall - less saturated fat, regular exercise, reducing stress overall.

Hanna went out to Adams birthday party tonight which was awesome for her. I'm hugely happy for her to go out and enjoy some life outside the kids. I don't expect her home until very late. Hopefully the kids don't wake up a bunch but it's not looking good...

Came home and chilled out with the kids and Hanna ran out to get groceries (her idea to do it that way). Once groceries were back we put Margs down for a nap and uncle Chad randomly popped by. 

It was fine. but he was in a "push buttons" mode. Challenging Hanna, challenging me, generally being rude and trying to just make people angry. Then he decided to playfully toss Asher headfirst into the hard part of the couch and really stunned him. Then told him to walk it off.... Kinda meh.

After that Hanna and I had a bit of grinding which I didn't quite understand - but I reinforced that if she was unhappy about anything I'm here to chat it out and be a part of the solution. Create avenues for her to feel safe and open to share these things when they happen. It turned out to be stuff from a year or more ago so I handled it well I thought. We both did. 

I ended up running out to valour, the first home match of the year (finally) and took extra time before I left to ensure Hanna and the kids were in a good space, and Hanna and I weren't grinding. Wouldn't want to leave her or the family in that kinda mode. Was going to be late for the kickoff but the weather was nuts so the game ended up being delayed for 2 hours.

Nevermind though, stuck it out, had a couple beers and celebrated a win at home, was a really good feeling to be there to support the boys in a win. You could tell they needed it too. A really good feeling as I drove away from the game, soaking wet but happy.

Unfortunately - Hanna had a rough bedtime with both kids solo. I know she's always said she was amazed I could do it solo, so I assumed she could do it too. But it didn't go very well - they had a great evening of crafts and drawing, fun activities together, but bedtime was hard..Asher wouldn't give her space to get Margs down and she lost her cool, pushing Asher into his room in the dark and he freaked out as he was very scared.

So I came home to a sad and self deprecating partner who was upset at herself and drained..it really does make it hard to want to go and do valour or things I enjoy when it could cause these things inadvertently. 

Did a bunch of chores. Cleaned the kitchen, garbage, recycling, made lunches and tidied up the toys and living room. Noticed how bad my hands and trigger finger are getting. Swelling feet etc. I am worried I have gout. Or worse.

Ugh. Anyway..early bed as the stadium snacks were not sitting well 😆 overall a decent day. Felt for Asher and Hanna though.

He's been a handful lately as he is going though a stage of development, needing full attention, and causing havoc when he doesn't get his way. I feel we need to start to really to connect consequences with actions but I'm not sure what or how that will go. Ah well. We love that kid and just want him to be happy. It's hard to be the rule enforcer.

Really scary and it really puts a lot in perspective. I hope she's ok. I hope Hanna is ok. I'm going to try to be more patient and check in softly when I can. 

Already got a load done tonight. Cleaned the main floor, got ghosty going, unloaded and loaded the dishes, and fixed the fridge.

Feeling pretty down. I made some mistakes with the groceries and ended up overspending and it really caused Hanna to feel triggered and upset with me which showed pretty intensely in front of the kids despite my apologies and efforts to redirect to be teammates. I know and understand it has a lot to do with resentment and anger from before and it's hard to not feel really shitty and want to beat myself up too. I am trying not to. 

We talked about the budgeting and taking over spending and how we may make mistakes and we'll work through them together but she was so angry about overspending at Costco and I just followed the list for the most part. I ended up returning about 100 bucks worth of stuff. Then doing the grocery remaining at superstore and we're still well over the 250 a week. I fucking hate inflation and the greed of our fucking economics systems. Honestly, fuck the rich. Fuck stockholders. Fuck them all. It's insane that the poor and middle class carry the duty of maintaining the riches profit. Disgusting. 

Anyway. We talked it out and I showed her the work I'm doing on budgeting and she suggested that she'll do monthly meal plans and then price out things each shop before I go or she goes. I really didn't want her to carry more but I guess she's not trusting me even tho I have removed all my weekly spending, have sold so many things to add money to our accounts and budget buckets. It sucks.

Poor Margs is exhausted so I'm just sitting in the car as she sleeps so she can get a good nap in. I feel pretty down and it's really easy for me to just hate myself and my efforts for not being perfect and making Hanna feel angry, scared and nervous. We're doing our best. We really are, and I'm not making decisions. I'm just trying to be collaborative and supportive, giving her the tools and information to feel empowered and on top of life. I don't wanna be the one to lead as I also don't wanna be the one to be blamed and yelled at when mistakes are made but yet, I am anyway.

Feeling like she's going to leave me again. Feeling scared and unsafe all the time. 

Like last night, she got on me immediately with a strong tone of frustration and criticism, about my voice carrying cause I was on a call with g. I never talk or hang with my friends, and we were much louder whenever we watch TV or movies or chat or laugh, and there was never any asking of me to talk quieter or about my voice carrying. Yet I'm on discord for 2 minutes literally and I'm being criticized..I didn't respond well and I apologized for being defensive but it felt like there is a lot of double standards and I don't understand them. It sucks to feel like sometimes I'm not really an equal to her despite all my constant work, efforts and actions, and if I talk about them, it's minimized as me selling myself or advocating for myself..there isn't anyway to succeed and feel good about myself lately as it only comes from me. 

Anyway. She just brought me a grilled cheese while I'm sitting in the car and that's nice. I know it'll be ok. At least I hope so. Everyone but me is against us succeeding. 😔

Sad days. And I need to take my meds. And have a coffee. Just bleh.

memos.content:
I'm not entirely sure what's going on the last few days but Hanna has seemed very short, critical, indirect and avoiding being open and honest. I'm not really sure what I'm doing, if anything, that would cause this change in dynamic as I'm still on top of the house, job hunt, letting her nap and rest, planning things with friends, and tackling big tasks. It makes me really sad and on edge, because I'm not feeling heard. I'm not feeling like she's really interested in talking to me, as she's often jumping to another task, a phone call, playing games on her phone, etc. it's really confusing and the more I try to create space to ask how she's doing, if everything is ok or what's on her mind, it's always "fine" and "nothing is wrong". If I share how I'm feeling or what I'm hearing in her tone she rejects it outright and just seems to shut down. And I know I can't push even though I feel like I'd be expected to be open and thoughtful if she was sharing something I was doing to upset or frustrate her. 

I've been really wanting to be more physical regularly and she's not in the mood. And when she says we'll have time, the time passes and she doesn't make any effort or interest to make it happen. So I'm going to try to just leave it for a while I guess even though, that goes against the communication goals she wants, and the ability to speak to each other honestly and authentically. I'm finding it hard to feel good about anything going on. 

I know I'm proud of myself and I'm in fantastic mental and physical places, and I'm just finding it hard to navigate when she's shutting down and letting things build until she suddenly goes off on me with criticism. I don't know if she knows she does this but I guess if the roles were reversed it would be an issue. Even lately when she wants to spend time together she's not really listening or interested in connection. I've been trying to let her know when I'm going to zone out or when I'm doing budgeting, and she says she'll have Margs but then she is doing something Else and I have to ask for help again. If she lets me know the same, if space is needed or she just wants to zone out, it makes it really easy to avoid these hurt feelings I'm having because then I know where she's at. 

I'm just feeling down about it because I'm so happy and I'm feeling like something is going on with her and she's not talking about it. It makes me worry that things are going to happen without conversation. That's scary.

Getting Margs down to nap. Hoped to have time to shower today, as it's been very busy, and I don't like waking the kids when I'm showering. Hoped to have time to job hunt and game a bit today but that's likely not going to happen either. I've just been grinding laundry, chores and cleaning. Making dinner tonight. 

Bleh. I miss connecting with Hanna. I don't know what is going on.

memos.content:
Hanna woke up and was feeling extremely off it seems, worried about a slide, but was struggling to speak to why. I tried to be as supportive, patient and open to feedback, as I have been everyday since mid January, and asked what had happened, what she was feeling and what led to that feeling. She continued to speak about a slide, to bad habits, and it was very confusing and scary for me. It felt like I was about to lose everything all over again without any understanding of what happened or how she felt this way.

Yesterday afternoon after our walk home and time eating at the Park Cafe, she spoke happily and openly about how light and amazing life had been feeling and how happy she was. Somehow, which is fair, things change, she felt entirely different and frustrated with me and our life. Yesterday Asher demanded a lot of TV and it being the weekend, which is Hannas preferable times to watch shows, or TV, we watched trolls and whatever Asher wanted to watch. I followed her lead and use her actions as a guide, as well as her feedback and direction when we talk about what we want and what's best for our family. So understandably, I was very scared and confused because she couldn't really speak to what I was doing. She spoke about me having the PC out. Which is only out when she wants it and when she feels comfortable. She spoke about me using the PC when she's gone, and I only do things for myself when Margs is asleep or doing her own thing, I am usually doing budgeting, chores, job hunting, to try to do the right things for our family and be on top of extras while I am not working. These are all actions I've taken based on our conversations and her feedback, and the goals and objectives we both have for our family. She mentioned me going to sell the popcorn machine for 100, which we both agreed to sell and would help put money in our budget, but she mentioned I directed that, and I felt that we did that together and I was trying to be proactive about getting things done as she has consistently shared is important for our family and her.  She spoke about how me wanting to be physical last night, the night before, and the 2 days before that as hard because she feels she's disappointed me, and I shared it's ok to be disappointed and that we still cuddled, kissed goodnight and said I love you before bed and I thought everything was ok. It's just so confusing and hard to navigate. She talked about how me sharing how much my back, neck and arm hurts from the shoveling, my fall on the ice, and holding Margs triggers her and that really hurt because it feels like I can't be my authentic self without that component being safely expressed. Again, with understanding how my actions and constant complaining before impacted her and contributed to her feeling off. It sucks to feel like I'm making so much space and time for her and her needs and her requests, and we talk about partnerships and healthy relationships but yet those habits aren't really extended to me yet. Which is somewhat understandable. I'm just hurt and scared. 

In the end she apologized and said she is just worried that one small thing or small changes could lead to a slide and I tried to assure her, remind her that my actions and intent everyday is to listen, take action and be proactively involved in everything our family needs. It scares me to death when this comes up as if I'm about to be booted out the door again and all this hard work, self improvement and health changes seem to be seen as minimally impactful. We had a big hug and I tried to once again say I'm sorry for how I was before, the poor habits and bad listening and poor partnership. I take full accountability and I have done nothing but do all the right things and try to be the partner she deserves every single day. The father and proactive family member our kids deserve. And I'm proud of myself, I really am but it's hard to feel good about myself when this happens.

I understand the impact of how I was before and my unhealthy self is deeply hurt for her and I dont ever want to shy away from that but I also need to be able to share when I'm hurting, how I'm feeling and when I have thoughts.

Anyway. Hope the day goes well. 🥲
